verdict.rationale: Yapily is an API-first platform. It authenticates with machine credentials (Application ID/Secret over HTTP Basic), offers OpenAPI-generated client libraries and a sandbox with test bank accounts, and reports status via webhooks, so scripted, non-interactive use is plausible. However, end-user consent typically depends on bank redirects and login screens. Embedded authorisation exists only for institutions with that feature, and nothing documents CI usage specifically. missing for 10: documented CI/headless workflow or CLI, non-interactive consent automation in sandbox, published OpenAPI spec endpoint (probe 404), hands-on corroboration.
